text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources:

WHEAT SALE - Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Saturday he bought 300,000 tonnes of wheat, including 150,000 tonnes each from the U.S. and France. From the U.S. it bought 50,000 tonnes of soft red winter (SRW) wheat at $176 per tonne, FOB, for Sept 1-15 loading; 50,000 of SRW wheat at $176, FOB, for Sept 1-30 loading; 50,000 of SRW wheat at $178, FOB, for Oct 1-31 loading. From France it bought 100,000 tonnes at $178 per tonne FOB, for October 10-31 loading; and 50,000 tonnes at $178, for October 5-31 loading.

CORN/SOYBEAN TENDERS - Taiwanese importers are expected in the market this week for a total of 74,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 118,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans, local traders said on Monday. The corn and soy are for September and October shipment.
WHEAT TENDERS - The Commodity Credit Corp of USDA (CCC) is to tender Tuesday for 33,000 tonnes of soft white wheat for donation to Bangladesh. Shipment is for Sept 10-Oct 5.
- The CCC is scheduled to tender Wednesday for 17,000 tonnes of dark northern spring (DNS) wheat for donation to Nicaragua. Shipment is for November 15-December 10.
WHEAT TENDERS - Moldova is to tender Tuesday for 35,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat (HRW) Title I PL-480 funding for shipment September 5 and 25.
- The CCC is scheduled to tender Wednesday for 16,000 tonnes of HRW, SRW or soft white wheat for donation to Tajikistan. Shipment is for Sept 15-Oct 10.
- Taiwan's Provincial Food Bureau will tender on August 28 for a 15,470-tonne shipment of U.S. No.1 wheat. Shipment is for Oct 1-20 from the Pacific Northwest.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka will tender on August 30 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S., Canadian or Argentinian wheat. It includes 50,000 tonnes of soft wheat for September shipment and 50,000 tonnes of hard wheat for October shipment.

- Jordan will tender August 28 for 90,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW or spring wheat and 10,000 of soft white or SRW wheat for first and second half October, No 2 or better wheat with option for equivalent origins in two 50,000-tonne lots.
SOYBEAN TENDER - Pakistan is to tender Wednesday for 30,000 to 34,000 tonnes of PL-480 No 2 yellow soybeans. Delivery is for Oct 15-30.

MARKET TALK - Indonesia wants to buy 200,000 tonnes of Thai rice on counter-trade terms, Thai deputy agriculture minister Amnuay Yodsuk said on Monday. Amnuay told reporters that Jakarta offered to buy various grades of Thai rice in exchange for two Indonesia-made CN-235 planes that could be used for agricultural purposes...USDA grain and soybean export inspections for the week ended August 22: soybeans 10.71 million bushels vs 13.436 million the previous week; wheat 30.905 million vs 25.260 million; corn 19.755 million vs 21.809 million; and sorghum 4.168 million vs 7.008 million.

MARKET TALK - The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday said freight coverage is now available for sales of U.S. wheat and rice to the West African region under the Export Credit Guarantee Program (GSM-102). USDA said the total 1996 authorization for sales to the West African region under GSM-102 remains unchanged at $50 million.
